instruction.text: Choose the correct word to complete the sentence.

atoms.a: My train fare was very expensive.
atoms.b: My train ((++fare fair)) was very expensive.

atoms.a: The concert last night was great.
atoms.b: The concert last night was ((++great grate)).

atoms.a: I can’t hear you, it’s too noisy.
atoms.b: I can’t ((++hear here)) you, it’s too noisy.

atoms.a: I secretly ate a piece of cake earlier.
atoms.b: I secretly ate a ((++piece peace)) of cake earlier.

atoms.a: You shouldn’t meddle in other people’s business!
atoms.b: You shouldn’t ((++meddle medal)) in other people’s business!

atoms.a: He let out a groan when he saw his homework.
atoms.b: He let out a ((++groan grown)) when he saw his homework.

atoms.a: The director stopped recording in the middle of the scene.
atoms.b: The director stopped recording in the middle of the ((++scene seen)).

atoms.a: I tried to tie my laces, but they ended up in a knot.
atoms.b: I tried to tie my laces, but they ended up in a ((++knot not)).
